title: Sunsational | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front with Private Pool and Beach Access | Sleeps 18 | Walk to Seaside- Sunsational by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Sunsational by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 51 S Andalusia Ave, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Welcome to Sunsational, one of the most breathtaking Seagrove Beach escapes redefining 30A luxury vacation rentals. This remodeled Gulf front estate spans nearly 5,000 square feet between the main home and carriage house, offering an elevated experience for those seeking luxury beachfront rentals 30A travelers dream about. Positioned among the most coveted 30A gulf front rentals, Sunsational features private beachfront access and panoramic views from nearly every room. Expansive balconies invite you to unwind above the shoreline, while the light-filled interiors and designer finishes create a seamless blend of comfort and sophistication. For those searching for 30A vacation rentals with private pool, this home delivers in spectacular fashion. The oversized pool overlooks the emerald waters, paired with an outdoor kitchen and generous entertaining space perfect for long, sun-soaked afternoons and unforgettable evenings. Ideal for large groups, Sunsational stands out among Seagrove Beach rentals, offering room for multi-generational families, reunions, corporate retreats, and group getaways. Whether you’re gathering for celebration, relaxation or both, this home offers the space, privacy, and luxury to make every moment exceptional! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Gulf-front with private beach access. - *Private heated Gulf front pool. - 5-minute bike ride to Seaside. - 5-minute ride to Cafe Thirty-A. - Game room with pool table. - Carriage house with full kitchen. - Dining for up to 18 guests. - Parking for 4 vehicles. *Pool heat is available for an additional $480 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 18 8 Bedrooms / 6 Full & 1 Half Baths First Floor: - Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath, Private Access to Pool Deck - Guest Room 2: King Bed with Private Bath, Private Access to Pool Deck - Kitchen / Living / Dining / Entertainment Room with Pool Table / Half Bath - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Guest Room 3: King Suite with Private Bath, Sleeper Sofa, Balcony with Panoramic Gulf Views, Pool Access - Guest Room 4: King Suite with Private Bath, Sleeper Sofa, Balcony with Panoramic Gulf Views, Pool Access - Guest Room 5: King Bed with Shared Bath - Guest Room 6: King Bed with Shared Bath - Guest Room 7: Bunk Room Twin/Twin with Shared Bath Carriage House: - Guest Room 8: King Bed with Private Bath - Full Kitchen, Living, Bar Seating, Sleeper Sofa Amenities Include: - 8 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Please Note: - Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. - For a link to the virtual tour of the carriage house, please contact our office. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach
